description: Compute a one-shot status summary for a PR: state, risk score (and whether it describes the current head), CI state for the head commit as the merge gate sees it (with `ci.failures`: for each failed run, the failed step, up to 8 file:line rows linked to the head sha, the tool's own guidance block and the full step log URL, or `{withheld, required, hint}` when this credential may not read the run's logs), AI-review verdicts (trio), gate signals, `merge` — the conflict probe the merge gate uses (status up-to-date | clean | conflicts | unknown, unresolved files with kinds, files settled by structured merge or the merge rules, conflictsUrl), auto-merge (armed? `last_attempt.reason` says what it waits for or what happens next), and `mergeTrain.lastDequeue` — the merge train's newest receipt for a green merge preview it did not merge (which commit, which runs, why). Read-only.
name: gluecron_pr_status_summary
